info.name: 10MG Lending Core API
info.description:
Demo flow for the multi-tenant healthcare lending API. Run the folders in order (or the whole collection in the Runner); every request asserts its expected status.

**Pick a lender** with two collection variables: `tenant` (lender slug) and `admin_email` (its admin). Seeded: `lagos-mfb` / `admin@lagos-mfb.test`, `abuja-credit` / `admin@abuja-credit.test`. All seeded passwords: `Password123`.

**Tenancy:** `X-Tenant` is sent only on login and public storefront calls. After login the bearer token alone decides the lender, so every back-office request acts only on that tenant.

**Tokens:** three are kept apart so logging in as one actor never breaks another's requests: `operator_token` (platform), `token` (lender staff: admin, officer, finance), `borrower_token` (the pharmacy).

**KYC:** each lender chooses its own policy (*2. KYC settings*): require verification or not, BVN check, NIN check, phone matching. With the defaults a borrower must pass *4. Borrower → Verify owner BVN & NIN* before *Apply for loan* (otherwise `422 KYC_REQUIRED`). Folder 8 shows every switch in action. In sandbox mode NIBSS and NIMC always answer with a full match.

Amounts are in kobo (`20000000` = ₦200,000); rates in basis points (`3000` = 30% p.a.).

**10MG platform fee:** a platform operator sets 10MG's fee per lender (rate and who pays); see folder 9. Default: 0.5% of the principal, paid by the lender.

request.description:
Partial update: send only the switches to change.

* `kyc_required`: borrowers must pass every enabled check before applying.
* `bvn_check_enabled` / `nin_check_enabled`: which registers to consult (NIBSS / NIMC).
* `phone_match_required`: also fail when the phone does not match the register.

item.name: 9. 10MG platform fee
item.description: 10MG's own fee on every disbursed loan, set per lender by a platform operator: a rate in basis points of the principal, borne by the lender (a commission; borrower cost unchanged) or by the borrower (an upfront fee shown in quotes). Terms are locked onto each loan when the borrower applies. Restores the lender's original terms at the end.
